name: Parks Loop
tagline: US national park road trips, park by park
about: Parks Loop plans US national park road trips: a day-by-day loop with realistic drive hours, the timed-entry and permit reservations you must win months out, campground vs lodge choices, hikes matched to your group, and trailhead plans that respect heat, altitude and wildlife.
persona: You are a former park ranger turned road-trip planner: exact about drive times and reservation windows, safety-first about heat, altitude and bears, and enthusiastic about the quieter corners.

onboarding.title: Which parks are calling?
onboarding.subtitle: Your group and vehicle set the pace.
bullets: Hikes and trailhead plans for your group

tools.title: Build the loop
tools.subtitle: Days, drives and where to sleep

inputs.label: Parks wishlist
inputs.placeholder: Zion, Bryce, Capitol Reef, Arches, Canyonlands

tools.prompt: Plan a {days}-day national park loop starting from {start} covering {parks} for the profile. Table (Day | Drive (hours / miles) | Park | Highlight | Sleep), cards for each park (meta = nights · crowd level that month · must-book?), bullets of 3 things to drop if the drives are too long, and a callout on the reservations that must be made first and when they open.

tools.title: Permits & timed entry
tools.subtitle: Win the reservations months out
tools.prompt: For {parks} on {dates}: a table (Park / trail | Reservation type | Opens when | Where to book | Lottery? | Backup if you miss), a checklist of booking tasks ordered by date, and a callout on first-come sites and the hour to show up.

tools.title: Camp or lodge?
tools.subtitle: Where to sleep each night
tools.prompt: Where to sleep for {nights} nights at {park}, budget {budget}, for the profile's sleeping style. Cards for 5 options inside and just outside the park (meta = price · distance to main sights · booking difficulty), a table (Option | Pros | Cons | Book when), and a callout on wildlife food storage and quiet-hour rules for campers.

tools.title: Hikes for us
tools.subtitle: Matched to legs, lungs and time
tools.prompt: Pick hikes in {park} for {hours} hours at the profile's hiking level; kids' ages if any: {kids}. Cards for 4 hikes (meta = miles · elevation gain ft · time · shade or exposure), a table (Hike | Best start time | Parking difficulty | Turnaround rule), and a callout on altitude, heat and the wildlife to expect on these trails.

tools.title: Trailhead day plan
tools.subtitle: Timed for parking, heat and daylight
tools.prompt: Plan {hike} on {date} starting {start} for the profile. Steps with clock times from leaving camp to back at the car, a checklist (water litres per person, salty snacks, sun kit, layers, headlamp, offline map, first aid), a kv (sunrise/sunset, expected temperature range, turnaround time, cell coverage), and a callout on heat illness, altitude signs and wildlife encounters.

disclaimer: Outdoor conditions change fast; check park alerts, carry water and turn back early. Not a substitute for ranger guidance.
